purpose: First integration study of an explicitly unproven cross-asset incremental-information hypothesis
universe_basis: Fixed liquid stock and declared market/sector proxies; not a point-in-time constituent screen
hypothesis: A stock lagging a positive shared market/sector move may subsequently catch up when its residual price movement begins to recover
paired_information_ablation: Own-stock six-feature ridge versus same features plus peer lag, using identical peer-admitted rows, training-only scaling, regularization, horizon, shocks and costs
pre_evaluation_refinement: Matched own-stock ablation added after acquisition but before any outcome study, following independent design review; preserve this distinction from original acquisition plan
economic_expression: Funded long HOLD versus WAIT; next permitted minute-grid entry; original illustrative costs and 3x stress
model_freeze: Training-only feature scaling and lag-gap coefficient; supervised fit frozen before holdout with one-minute embargo
data_gates: no synthetic replacement of missing provider data
source retrieval time distinct from assumed historical availability
no quote execution claim from bars
acceptance: Pipeline consistency and descriptive paired comparisons only; five held-out sessions cannot establish statistical edge
kill_conditions: advantage confined to the artificial catch-up control
registration_scope: Written before requests in this session; local ordering is not independent preregistration authentication
